name: paywall
title: Paywall
description: A subscription screen: a glowing mark, a self-advancing feature carousel and swipeable plan cards.

perf.budget: The mark turns on the UI thread; the feature phones and dots follow the scroll in worklets. The carousel advances on a timer with one scroll per step. Plan cards are plain views.

measurements.notes: Animating at rest: the mark keeps turning while the paywall is open; the carousel advances every 4 s.

a11y.reducedMotion: The mark holds still, the carousel does not advance on its own and pages change without scrolling.
a11y.screenReader: The title is a header. Only the current feature is exposed and the dots read "Feature 2 of 3". Each plan reads its monthly price, what is billed and the saving; its button names the plan and shows when it is busy.
a11y.touchTarget: Close, the links and the plan buttons are at least 44 pt.
